records.title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents
records.reason: This paper analyzes how model growth, recursion and boundary operators change pretraining scaling exponents. The text situates looping as inference-time compute scaling and parameter efficiency, but its experiments concern scaling behavior during training rather than a serving intervention or measured inference resource improvement. The relation to inference-scale surveys is indirect.

records.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers
records.reason: The study geometrically analyzes finite-step failures in looped Transformers and identifies recoverable utility losses within recurrent inference steps. The full text defines looping as an inference-time compute resource and tests interventions on path direction/step count, but reports no latency or serving-efficiency result and proposes no resource-saving deployment method; retain as adjacent analysis only.

records.title: SlotDiT: Object-Centric Representations for Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: Object-centric representation for diffusion transformers; generative image/video modeling, not LLM inference.

records.title: Can VLMs Reliably Assess Sidewalk Accessibility Attributes from Pedestrian-Level Imagery?
records.reason: Evaluates sidewalk-accessibility attribute recognition; no inference efficiency method.

records.reason: Test-time training for image restoration; vision restoration rather than LLM inference/serving.
